Maya CSM: Heads up — BeaconFoods account health fell off a cliff. 14d active seats down ~42% and renewal in ~36 days. New Head of Data (Eva Park) started last week and we've observed a ScoutAI pilot. Need triage.

jonathan_csm: Can you paste the raw metrics and any recent notes? :eyes:

Maya CSM: Quick snapshot — https://console.redwood.ai/accounts/beaconfoods/health :
```
14d active seats: 12 -> 7
avg tokens/day: 45k -> 18k
most active routes: ingestion (big drop), search, analytics
recent changes: ingest-team lead left ~10d ago
```
Also found a job post and a ScoutAI trial announcement, started ~3 days ago. :warning:

liam_sales: We scoped on-prem and fine-tuning questions two weeks ago. ScoutAI spun up a hosted NER pilot yesterday. I have a neutral demo scheduled Friday. Recommend we move quickly.

sophia_csm: Immediate playbook suggestion: 1) 15m intro call with Eva + current champions; 2) Offer 60-day dedicated trial with perf SLAs; 3) Deliver a one-sheet comparing latency/cost and on-prem/migration support vs ScoutAI. Also invite execs to a quick QBR.

maya_csm: I'll ask for an intro to Eva. Who can make the one-sheet? Need ingestion numbers (latency, ops cost) and migration notes.

ops_bot: Alert — renewal window: 36 days. health_score: 82 -> 45 in last 14d. flags: usage_drop, stakeholder_change.

jonathan_csm: I'll pull the 7d usage export + alert diff and kick off the churn-risk playbook. Maya, can you share the minimal queries or logs?

Maya CSM: CLI snippet for export (token sanitized):
```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer xxxxx" \
  "https://console.redwood.ai/accounts/beaconfoods/usage?range=7d&format=csv" -o beacon_7d.csv
```
I'll DM the csv to the group. :pray:

liam_sales: I'll draft a counter-offer if we confirm feature parity gaps. Sophia, can you write a 10-12 line outreach script for Eva that highlights on-prem option, recent perf wins, and migration support? Keep it exec-friendly.

sophia_csm: On it. Looping in solutions eng for parity and demo notes — @nate_eng can you confirm ingestion rerank latency and fine-tune availability?

nate_eng: Happy to help. Quick Q: which ScoutAI features are they trialing that matter most?

maya_csm: They advertised "private repo fine-tune" and ~100ms reranking for ingestion. Need to verify if those are pilot-only claims.

jonathan_csm: Timeline: materials by Thu EOD, outreach Fri AM, demo Fri 3pm if accepted. Any blockers?

liam_sales: Good. I'll prepare pricing sketch for a 60-day dedicated trial with SLA.

sophia_csm: No blockers. I'll post the script and one-sheet in this thread when ready.

Maya CSM: Creating calendar invites and updating the renewal playbook now. Will post summary + next steps after call. :memo:

jonathan_csm: I'll attach usage export and a short risk heatmap once I have it.

Maya CSM: Thanks team — moving to action.
